title: Integrating Real-World Search Problem Applications and Ethical Considerations
text: Consider adding a subsection under "Illustrative Learning Outcomes" or "Non-core" content that addresses real-world applications and ethical dimensions of search algorithms. For example: Analyze the use of heuristic search in real-world systems such as GPS navigation, automated scheduling, or resource allocation in cloud computing. This grounds abstract concepts in tangible examples and enhances student engagement. Critically evaluate ethical implications of heuristic-based decision-making in sensitive domains (e.g., job applicant ranking, automated loan approvals), linking search strategy design with fairness, transparency, and accountability.
